recommendation: Keep the source fix. If FHIR-I wants a future generalized build-time warning, implement it in the current publisher/tooling repository; the active core search-parameter sources now satisfy the current-spec part of FHIR-12728.
issue_request: FHIR-12728 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 by FHIR-I and asked that all Event and Request pattern resources have an encounter search parameter, in addition to the historical context parameter, plus a warning when the parameter is missing.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 0565e3795f added encounter as a standard search criterion to both Event and Request pattern spreadsheets, and df6f87077f (svn build@11224, cited by Jira) added the validator warning. Later workflow work, especially FHIR-17901, renamed the pattern element from context to encounter.
additional_context: Current source keeps Event and Request as active logical patterns and includes AdverseEvent, ClaimResponse, DetectedIssue, and GuidanceResponse as active resources. Those resources have Encounter-bearing encounter elements or Event-family evidence but lacked authored encounter search parameters. DocumentReference was left unchanged because later OO decisions FHIR-29801 and FHIR-54170 intentionally use DocumentReference.context for the broadened Appointment/Encounter/EpisodeOfCare search surface.
reconciliation: Added resource-specific encounter SearchParameter entries to source/adverseevent, source/claimresponse, source/detectedissue, and source/guidanceresponse search-parameter bundles. Did not add AllergyIntolerance because it was not an Event/Request pattern resource in the checked workflow evidence, and did not add DocumentReference-encounter because the later approved code is context.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Event/Request context to encounter and moved EpisodeOfCare support to a workflow extension; already represented on the combined branch.
Renamed DocumentReference.encounter/search parameter to DocumentReference.context and broadened targets, so DocumentReference was not re-added as encounter.
Clarified the later DocumentReference.context wording for Appointment/EpisodeOfCare support.
Separate MedicationStatement/MedicationDispense encounter/context search request already represented on the combined branch.
